text:
Ava: Quick mid-q check: landing-pages milestone — what shipped, what slipped, who still has CRs? Short bullets please.

Sam: Shipped: feature flag + staged rollout (backend + frontend). PRs merged: #4123 (backend), #4124 (frontend).
Slipped: image optimization work. Blocked by third-party lib upgrade the perf team needs to validate.
Owning: Sam = backend, Riya = frontend. CR ping: @Riya can you review #4130 (frontend small refactor)? @Jorge need infra signoff for LB/canary config.

Riya: On it — will review #4130 today. Found one edge case (gif handling) that needs a test, easy patch. ETA: EOD. :thumbsup:

Jorge: Infra note: canary infra is green but requires a small LB config change (stickiness + healthcheck tweaks). I can apply once we have the terraform diff from @Sam. Also recommend we hold wide rollout until image perf tests pass.

Lia: From PM side — customers on beta get notified Wed. If rollout slides, I will postpone external comms. Marketing hold if we delay.

Sam: Terraform diff (mini) pasted below — added `canary_enabled` flag and LB tweak.
```hcl
resource "aws_lb_target_group" "lp_canary" {
  name     = "lp-canary"
  port     = 443
  protocol = "HTTPS"
  health_check {
    path                = "/healthz"
    interval            = 10
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
  }
}
variable "canary_enabled" {
  type    = bool
  default = true
}
```
Will push PR with diff now.

deploybot: deploybot: staging deploy succeeded for landing-pages-flag v1.3.2 — logs: link to pipeline (ci/redwood/landing-pages/staging). :white_check_mark:

Ava: Next steps: @Riya finish CR; @Jorge apply LB config when PR lands; @Sam coordinate the lib upgrade with @Kai (perf) and infra. If blocker remains by 17:00 PT today, escalate to oncall.

Riya: :eyes: starting review now. I will add the test and push a patch commit.

Kai: I'll take the lib upgrade. ETA tomorrow morning to finish validation and run image perf bench. Will set a narrow canary for verification.

Sam: Thanks. I'll hold wide rollout until Kai confirms perf.

Lia: OK I'll update the roadmap doc and move the customer comms slot. Can someone add a one-liner to the weekly sync doc?

Riya: Added short status line to weekly doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/weekly/landing-pages (note: internal link).

Ava: Thanks all. One more ask — rollback/runbook? If image perf regresses after canary, what's the quick rollback? @Jorge please outline runbook steps.

Jorge: Runbook (short): 1) Flip `canary_enabled=false` via feature flag, 2) Terraform revert of lb changes (apply revert diff), 3) Scale down canary target group to 0, 4) Re-route traffic. I will add full steps to the runbook and link.

Sam: I'll attach the revert diff in the PR for fast revert.

Ava: Great. If anything blocks after Kai's bench, update this thread. Otherwise we'll reconvene in tomorrow's async status doc. :handshake:
